principles.title: Generate a weekly grocery list

workflow.title: Export

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.subtitle: Browse the app flow in chapters. The media slots support screenshots or any asset you place in /public/tutorial.
tutorial.assetHint: These visuals load from /public/tutorial and can be replaced with screenshots at any time.

chapters.title: Account setup
chapters.summary: Register once, then sign in with either your username or email address plus password.
steps: Open the landing page.
Choose Register if you are new, or Log in if the account already exists.
Use a password with at least eight characters.
The login form accepts username or email, whichever is easier to remember.

asset.alt: Landing page with the auth panel
asset.caption: The landing page keeps the sign-in flow visible without hiding the product story.

chapters.title: Import AH recipes
chapters.summary: Paste an Allerhande URL and let the backend parse the recipe, ingredients, instructions, and base servings.
steps: Open the Recipes tab.
Paste an AH Allerhande recipe URL.
Start the async import job to show a live queued and parsing state.
When the job succeeds, the recipe appears in your collection.

asset.caption: Recipe import uses a visible status card so the parser never feels opaque.

chapters.title: Import AH products
chapters.summary: Save the items you already buy so grocery items can be matched back to your product catalog.
steps: Open the Products tab.
Paste an AH product URL.
Import the product to store title, price, image, unit, and AH identifier.
Imported products are available for shopping list matching.

asset.caption: Imported products become part of your personal catalog for later matching.

chapters.title: Build the week menu
chapters.summary: Assign recipes to weekdays and choose how many people will eat each meal.
steps: Open Week menu.
Choose a recipe from the collection.
Pick a day and person count.
Add or remove entries until the week plan feels right.

asset.caption: Week planning stays readable by grouping entries per day.

chapters.title: Generate the grocery list
chapters.summary: Aggregate ingredient quantities, show product matches, and copy the export text when you are ready to shop.
steps: Open the Grocery list / cart tab.
Generate the list from the current week plan.
Review the matched products or AH search links.
Copy the export text into the app or workflow you prefer.

asset.caption: The export panel makes the shopping intent explicit instead of hiding it behind a generic list.

chapters.title: Async import jobs
chapters.summary: Recipe imports run in the background, which makes parsing state visible and predictable.
steps: Create a job with the recipe URL.
Poll the job endpoint until it becomes succeeded or failed.
Refresh the recipe list once the job completes.
Use this flow whenever you want visible loading feedback.

asset.caption: The job timeline gives the UI a truthful loading state without guessing.
